hypothesis: For this source, applying the generated moving caption atlas across a full rectangular strip shifted legs and floor. Restricting replacement to source glyph components reduced broad displacement but left local floor and jeans defects. Checking the blurred final CTA interval exposed a sharp-ending band and trimming the replacement before that interval removed the band. This is one-source, sampled evidence; it does not validate natural restoration, watermark removal or exact audiovisual timing. A platform done status did not prove complete delivery: actual material readback still needed the eighth German record.
limitations: Single-source sampled visual evidence; direct phoneme listening and comparative audio-model review unavailable.
Fireplay 8/8 acceptance is separate from internal quality and user acceptance.
promotion: Candidate only; no default or policy changes.
evidence_boundary: Technical observation and hashes; raw private case is not needed to read this hypothesis. Activation requires independently packaged reviewed evidence.
